title: GURA
subtitle: Sentiment Analysis Model
description: The earlier BiGRU + self-attention sentiment experiment. Preserved for reference; current comparisons live in Sentiment Bundle Benchmark.
longDescription: A historical sentiment classifier used to introduce the MyAnimeList reviews and sentiment dataset bundle. The archived BiGRU experiment has been replaced by sentiment-bundle-benchmark, which compares modern methods with fixed data splits and reproducible evaluation.
features: Companion to the MyAnimeList sentiment datasets
results: Preserved as the historical baseline for Sentiment Bundle Benchmark
